comparison: Matched single-factor control vs unified-v11 (16/16 PASS) with Laws 1-3, lr, multipliers, sparse prior masking, and zero-pinv direction_blend held 100% identical.
conclusion: Rung 1 (law4_pure_sgd, pure unnormalized SGD at matched lr=0.014, d_lr_mult=1.5, prior_lr_mult=2.9) scores 2/13 executed PASS (9 numerical FAIL, 2 NaN-explosion INCOMPLETE via FloatingPointError, 3 prereq-gated) on r4-occam-ablation-v1 vs unified-v11 16/16 PASS. Pure SGD passes easy 2D vectors (vector_unequal_width hq=0.9990, vector_unequal_mass hq=0.9963) proving lr=0.014 is well-scaled, yet collapses on img_bars4 (0/4 modes, hq=0.0), grid100 (prec=0.1466), five_word_joint_smoke (3/5 modes, tv=0.4018), t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (1/4 modes, hq=0.1348), t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (0/4 modes, hq=0.0469), ring16 (hq=0.8071), gaussian1d_smoke (cdf_ks=0.0820), zero_tanh_smoke, model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0=1.328), and immediately blows up to NaN (FloatingPointError: nonfinite public training loss) on both >500x imbalanced Nash tasks.

hypothesis: Evaluate law4-pure-sgd (Rung 1 (Pure Unnormalized SGD): replace unified_v11_equil with pure unnormalized SGD (p.add_(g, alpha=-lr)) on G, D, and sampled prior rows (keeping Laws 1-3, lr=0.014, d_lr_mult=1.5, prior_lr_mult=2.9, sparse prior masking, and zero-pinv direction_blend identical to unified-v11).) across all 16 surgical probes of r4-occam-ablation-v1 under protocol seed 0 (lr=0.014, d_lr_mult=1.5, prior_lr_mult=2.9 held identical to unified-v11) to establish the exact causal SGD & G/D asymmetry ladder.
next_action: Compare against Rung 2 (law4-sgd-secant) to isolate whether player-level secant trust bands rescue pure SGD, and against Rungs 3-5 (asymmetric SGD-on-G, reverse control SGD-on-D, and zero-state Frob-SGD+MP).
